model_card.name: Flood loss cost model: Hybrid GLM fxs + state factor (VA, NC, MD)
model_card.structure: frequency GLM (Poisson, log link, exposure offset) x severity GLM (Gamma, log link), both with state x year effects absorbed into a state factor, x large-loss load x ICC bridge x off-balance (per state); NO county factor (it made unseen years worse in NC: reports/10_county_form_summary.csv)

validation.yardstick: re-based Tweedie (p = 1.5) deviance improvement vs no-features model; each unseen year once, scored within each state

model_card.why_not_xgboost: Milestone 11's decision rule re-applied on three states in Milestone 13 (reports/10_multistate.md).

disclaimer: Area-level estimate from aggregated public NFIP data (Virginia, North Carolina and Maryland, 2010-2025). It describes the average insured building with these characteristics in this county in an average year. It is NOT a quote, a premium, or a prediction for any individual property.
